reddit.title: Improving Lake Performance in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant optimizations to how flowing lakes are processed in Provincia. Now, drying one cell only affects its immediate neighbors rather than rescanning the entire map. This change reduces the script time for a 64×64 lake from about 20 ms to 12 ms, improving overall performance. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.body: In our latest update, we've optimized the processing of flowing lakes in Provincia. Now, drying one cell only affects its immediate neighbors, significantly reducing script time and enhancing performance. This means a smoother experience as you build your colony.
